text:
Omar: Heads-up: we saw invoice flaps on EU tenants after the CDN edge started returning routed=eu-2 for some requests. The billing pipeline’s region attribution appears inconsistent for ~0.01% of requests.
Jia: any sample events?
Omar: snippet:
```
2026-04-02T04:12:15Z tenant=hera tokens=210 region=eu-1
2026-04-02T04:12:15Z tenant=hera tokens=5 region=eu-2
```
Same second, different region tags.
Ravi: sounds like asg-level sticky hashing occasionally flips when node drains. Our ledger groups by tenant+session+region_key which causes double-counting when region_key flips mid-session.
Omar: we should probably normalize region attribution at the edge earlier. But patching edge is slow.
Jia: short-term: during invoicing, run a coalescer that picks a canonical region per-session using majority token weight. That should be safe.
Ravi: agree. For long-term: we can propagate an explicit region_stable_id in the session handshake so backend can't disagree.
costbot: Created TASK COST-4122 with severity=P3.
Omar: also add console annotation to show "region_confidence" when >0.1% of events disagree per-session.
Jia: will add metric: "region.attribution_conflicts". We'll chart on per-tenant dashboard.
Ravi: dev note: pseudo for coalescer:
```
group_by tenant+session
region_counts = count_tokens_per_region(events)
chosen_region = argmax(region_counts)
emit aggregated row with chosen_region
```
Omar: schedule backfill for window 2026-04-02 04:00-05:00. Also create customer comms if invoices change.
Jia: will draft comms. Keep billing-alerts in the loop.
Ravi: thanks, team.
